stem.text: The diagram shows a phloem sieve tube element and a companion cell that are involved in translocation of sucrose.

stem.alt: Outline of a sieve tube element beside a companion cell, with a row of pores between them and the labels W, X, Y and Z.

stem.text: Which process correctly describes the translocation of sucrose through these cells?

A.text: Sucrose moves from Y to Z by active transport.

B.text: Protons move from Y to Z by active transport.

C.text: Protons move from Z to Y by diffusion.

D.text: Protons move from X to W by diffusion.
